coverage_exempt.reason: Runs only when operator new returns 0. The original then zeroes EDI and unconditionally loads the vtable word at [EDI] at 0x445a2e, so it faults. The native body must keep the read, not add a guard.

Runs only when the table grow routine 0x4db6e0 returns 0. Its single zero-return exit follows a failed realloc with EBP holding the zero result, and calls 0x4dc680, which loads [EBP+4]. The original faults before returning.

Second range check, reached only if the entry at 0x445b73 is nonzero yet outside the table. After a successful first-pass grow the entry address is the start of the freshly zero-filled area, so it is zero and takes the 0x445bf2 branch. An in-range first pass leaves the same bounds. The check cannot fail.
Failure arm of the unreachable second range check (0x445b8e), and itself only entered after 0x4db6e0 fails, which faults at 0x4dc680 with EBP zero.

Near-zero linear branch, taken only when the squared-length scalar times 0.25 lies in [-0.1, 0.1]. The function stores 2000.0 at this+0x40 on entry and that component enters the sum of squares, so the scalar is at least 4e6 (or NaN, which takes the other branch). Checked with a stack simulation of the instruction sequence and the data constants 0.25 at 0x50df30 and 0.1 at 0x513e20.

notes: Boundary reviewed against corpus disassembly; packet NOTES records object layouts, x87 branch semantics, transitive imports and original null-dereference paths requiring coordinator review.
